title: Parallax Veil Arena
description: A surreal fantasy arena constructed from torn fragments of antique maps, featuring broken classical columns, floating map banners, and three braziers with green magical flames. In the background a giant ornate circular astrolabe-like structure floats above a mountainous landscape under a dramatic dusk sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy arena made from torn pieces of old illustrated maps and parchment, broken ancient Greek columns with map banners hanging from them, three braziers emitting green magical fire, a massive intricate golden astrolabe floating in the sky, mountainous backdrop, dramatic twilight lighting, epic and mystical atmosphere, painted in a detailed fantasy illustration style
